Orthogonal vertices u=sec(alpha)e_alpha and v=sec(alpha)e_(alpha+pi/2), with t=tan(alpha) and c=sqrt2 cos(alpha), satisfy N(cu)^2+N(ctv)^2=2, while u±tv=sec(alpha)^2 e_(2alpha or 0), exactly facet normal rays, yielding equality. Square n=1 gives 2, octagon n=2 gives 2sqrt(2-sqrt2), and sec expansion yields the displayed asymptotic. The existence proof does not classify all extremizers.
